name: Gabriella Leal
source:
This year, Gabriella, a lively and cheerful latina, enrolled at Cordale in the Crowhive house. She is interested in martial magic and is a regular at the Dueling club. Among other students, Gabi has a reputation of a dangerous and ruthless rival, though she looks like she could hurt a fly.

Season 2
[spoiler] Lively and cheerful latina Gabriella is a first-year student from Crowhive. She loves duelling and battle magic above all else. After Jacob died protecting me, she lost her smile. The loss of her favourite teacher devastated her. [/spoiler]
